name: Fireplace
source:
It's a snow day in the winter. You are hanging out with your three friends Yoru, Jay, and Blake. They decide that this is the perfect time to have a nice time by the fireplace. How does it go? It's up to you to decide.

[From [url=https://daikuwu.itch.io/fireplace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 冬日下雪，正好休息一天。你和Yoru、Jay、Blake三位朋友待在一起。他们觉得此刻最适合围坐在壁炉边，享受一段美好时光。接下来会发生什么？由你决定。[引自[url=https://daikuwu.itch.io/fireplace]Itch.io[/url]]
